title: Simple Steps to be Prepared for Emergencies
description:
Take simple steps that help keep you and your loved ones safe during emergencies. September is National Preparedness Month. 

Build a Kit: Gather essential supplies like water, non‑perishable food, medications, flashlights, and important documents.  

Make a Plan: Know where to go, who to contact, and how to stay connected. Talk with your family so everyone understands what to do if you’re separated or need to evacuate.

Stay Informed: Sign up for local alerts. Staying informed ensures you can respond quickly and confidently when emergencies arise.

For more information, visit sandiego.gov/oes/emergencypreparedness.
